headline: Brazilian States Abandon Tax Substitution Regime Ahead of Reform
summary: Brazilian states such as São Paulo have removed over 400 goods from the tax substitution regime in 2026, forcing retailers to recalculate compliance ahead of the broader tax reform.
why: Changes to state-level tax collection mechanisms alter compliance costs and operational accounting for the retail sector.

impacts.name: Brazilian Retail Sector
impacts.why: Retailers must redo tax calculations due to states leaving the substitution regime.
